items.title: Thinking in System
items.author: Donella H Meadow
items.quote: Pengantar yang baik tentang bagaimana melihat dunia disekitar kita sebagai sebuah sistem yang terhubung, once you adopt the system thinking you are able to see a problem in a more connected and comprehensive ways

items.title: Bumi Manusia
items.author: Pramoedya Ananta Toer
items.quote: Novel tentang identitas manusia identitas dan arti resistensi. Sintesa kuat tentang arti perlawanan terhadap ketidakadillan dan pentingnya menghidupkan kegelisahan terhadapan status quo di sekitar kita

items.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
items.author: Daniel Kahneman
items.quote: The book that rewired how I notice my own reasoning. System 1 and System 2 are now the lenses I can't stop using.

items.title: Zero to One
items.author: Peter Thiel
items.quote: A short book with an unfashionable claim: most value comes from the parts of the problem nobody else has looked at.

items.title: The Design of Everyday Things
items.author: Don Norman
items.quote: Once you read this, you can never un-see the bad door handles of the world. That's a compliment.

items.title: Range
items.author: David Epstein
items.quote: A defence of generalists that finally made me stop apologising for having wide interests. The data is on our side.
